text:
ava-marketing: FYI ops just flagged a regional degradation in eu-west affecting embeddings and completion latency. Need marketing-approved customer language and a communications timetable. We also have a partner webinar in 2 hours.

 diego-ops: started ~12:42 UTC, p95 up ~4x and sporadic 5xx for eu-west endpoints. Rolling rollback to last stable config in progress. No evidence of data exposure. ETA to restore normal service ~20-40m, will update sooner if done.

 sara-cs: Ask: account teams want a paste-able AM line + a brief support email for affected Dedicated/private customers. Also: flag any impacted paid trials.

 omar-product: Suggest we avoid technical terms on status page. Keep it customer-focused: what they see, what were doing, and actions they can take.

 ava-marketing: Draft status page copy (v0):
```
Incident: Elevated latency and errors in EU (eu-west)
Impact: Some customers may experience slow responses or intermittent errors for requests routed to EU.
What we're doing: Engineers are rolling back a recent config change and monitoring traffic.
Workaround: If you're seeing errors, try retrying after 10 seconds. Dedicated/private customers can request temporary routing assistance via support.
Next update: in 30 minutes
```

 cal-sales: For AMs: need a 1-line: "We're seeing degraded performance in EU inference; engineers are mitigating—next update in 30m. Open a support ticket for priority help." Also flag any customers running live demos.

 sara-cs: Tone tweak: swap "are seeing" -> "may be experiencing" per legal. Also add confirmation clause once ops confirms no data exposure.

 legal: Please avoid definitive SLA language. Use "may be impacted" and do not promise routing unless support confirms manual changes available.

 diego-ops: We can do manual Dedicated routing within 20 minutes of a ticket. Not automated. I'll confirm in the support template.

 ava-marketing: Webinar call: Recommend removing live perf demos and skip any benchmark slides. Swap to roadmap + customer stories. Also prep a brief note to partners to set expectations.

 omar-product: Agreed. We'll remove benchmark claims until postmortem. Can the webinar host read a short script acknowledging we're monitoring an EU issue and that live perf metrics are postponed?

 cal-sales: I'll message partners and top customers. Need exact one-liner to paste into partner comms.

 ava-marketing: AM/partner one-liner (v1): "We're aware of degraded performance in our EU inference region; engineers are mitigating. We'll provide an update in ~30 minutes. For priority support, open a ticket and reference 'EU inference impact.'"

 sara-cs: OK but change "degraded performance" -> "elevated latency and intermittent errors" to be specific.

 ava-marketing: Revised one-liner: "We're aware of elevated latency and intermittent errors in the EU inference region; engineers are mitigating. We'll provide an update in ~30 minutes. For priority support, open a ticket and reference 'EU inference impact.'"

 diego-ops: Incident logged INC-2026-044 by ops-bot; owner assigned. I'll post the 30-minute update.

 ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-044 created  severity: high  owner: diego-ops.

 legal: Quick signoff: wording looks fine; remove promise of exact ETA, say "expected update" instead of "will provide an update."

 ava-marketing: Finalized status copy and AM one-liner per legal. Plan: (1) publish status page now, (2) AM/partner one-liner out immediately, (3) Dedicated/private support email within 45 minutes after ops confirms manual routing availability, (4) webinar move: swap slides + host script. No external benchmark or blog posts until postmortem.

 cal-sales:  shared one-liner with partners.

 sara-cs:  prepping Dedicated email template; will wait for ops confirmation of manual routing.

 diego-ops:  will update here when routing option is confirmed and when resolved. Current rollback in progress.

 ava-marketing: Thanks all. Drop :white_check_mark: if youre aligned so I can push the status update.

 omar-product: \u2705 aligned.

 cal-sales: \u2705 aligned.

 sara-cs: \u2705 aligned (email queued).

 diego-ops: \u2705 ops aligned, will post updates.

 ava-marketing: Posting status now and sending partner note. Will reconvene if scope grows or we need to update webinar plan further.
